items.problem: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 emits a false '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency' on every correct migration that defers nothing.
items.evidence: session-log.txt Turn 31 (line 2245) and Turn 33 (line 2277): WARN present in both validator runs despite an overall PASS; DEFERRED file holds only the seeded '| (none) | — |' placeholder.
items.root_cause: The validator's no-defer PASS branch keyed off the literal phrase 'No items deferred', which Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 never writes (it seeds a '| (none) | — |' table row). The two scripts were out of sync, making the PASS branch dead and the WARN branch always fire when nothing is deferred.
items.change: Rewrote Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 §4 no-defer branch to classify structurally: count real DEFERRED table data rows (excluding header/separator and the seeded '| (none) |' placeholder). PASS when zero real rows; WARN only when the DEFERRED file lists actual files while the mapping has no defer rows.
items.expected_effect: Defer-nothing migrations report '[PASS] No defer rows; MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md correctly lists no deferred items' instead of a misleading WARN, while genuine mapping/DEFERRED inconsistencies still WARN.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any scenario that defers no files, the validator prints the '[PASS] No defer rows...' line and no 'check consistency' WARN; a scenario with a real defer row still validates, and an orphaned DEFERRED entry still WARNs.

deferred_to_human: Theme parity (UWP dark vs WinUI light) is a capture-environment/system-default difference; if consistent dark/light parity is desired it belongs to the eval capture harness (Tier 0), not the migration skill.
